philosophy: Airbnb-level craft meets Jony Ive restraint. One palette, one type scale, one spacing grid, one shadow. Empathy in every pixel. Ship beauty incrementally — each task leaves the app better than before.

tasks.name: Design Tokens & Foundation
tasks.description: Establish the single source of truth for every visual decision. Nothing else ships until this is solid.

subtasks.name: Create tokens.ts
subtasks.description: Single file exporting all design tokens. Replace every hardcoded hex across the codebase. Structure: colors (brand, semantic, neutrals), spacing (8px grid), radii, shadows, typography scale.

colors.brand: #1A1A2E (primary dark) + 1 signature accent (pick: warm coral #FF6B6B, deep indigo #4F46E5, or rich teal #0D9488)

spec.font: Inter (import from Google Fonts or use system-ui fallback)

subtasks.name: Create <Text> semantic component
subtasks.description: Replace ThemedText with a new component supporting variants: h1, h2, h3, body, bodyBold, caption, label, link. Each maps to type_scale + line_height + weight from tokens. Supports color override prop.

subtasks.name: Create <Card> base component
subtasks.description: Single card primitive with size variants (sm/md/lg) controlling padding (16/24/32). Background: white. Border-radius: radii.lg (24). Shadow: shadows.md. No borders ever. Optional tint prop for subtle background wash (rgba of semantic color at 0.04 opacity).

subtasks.name: Create <Button> component
subtasks.description: Variants: primary (filled accent), secondary (outlined), ghost (text only). Sizes: sm (40h), md (48h), lg (56h). Full-width by default. Border-radius: radii.full. No tiny pill buttons anywhere.

subtasks.name: Purge all hardcoded colors
subtasks.description: Search-and-replace every raw hex value (#2196F3, #1e1e1e, #007AFF, #34C759, etc.) across all components and screens. Point them to tokens.ts imports. Zero tolerance for magic values.

tasks.test: Every color, spacing value, font size, and shadow in the app traces back to tokens.ts. No hardcoded values remain.

tasks.name: Typography Overhaul
tasks.description: Ship one typeface used with discipline. Kill all engineering jargon from user-facing text.

subtasks.name: Install Inter font
subtasks.description: Add Inter via expo-google-fonts or @fontsource/inter. Configure in app _layout.tsx. Weights needed: 400 (regular), 500 (medium), 600 (semibold), 700 (bold). Remove all platform-specific font stacks from theme.ts.

subtasks.name: Apply type scale globally
subtasks.description: Audit every text element. Map to strict scale: 12/14/17/22/28/34. Kill all rogue sizes (16px body, 18px card title, 20px headers, 24px title — all non-standard). Use the new <Text> component everywhere.

subtasks.name: Rewrite user-facing copy
subtasks.description: Remove: 'Plaid x OpenClaw PoC', 'Test Connection', 'Refresh Data', any status codes or technical labels. Replace with human language: 'Your Money', 'Connected', 'Accounts'. Every string should pass the 'would my mom understand this?' test.

tasks.test: Only Inter renders. Every text element uses <Text> with a named variant. No jargon visible anywhere in the app.

tasks.name: Spacing & Layout Grid
tasks.description: Introduce an 8px grid. Add whitespace everywhere. Make it breathe.

subtasks.name: Enforce 8px grid on all screens
subtasks.description: Audit every margin, padding, gap. Replace with nearest 8px multiple from tokens.spacing. Current offenders: 10px, 15px, 30px, 60px — all become 8/16/32/64. Use spacing constants, never raw numbers.

subtasks.name: Set max content width
subtasks.description: Wrap all screen content in a centered container with maxWidth: 480 on web. Add horizontal padding of 24px. This gives the premium mobile-first feel on desktop (like Monzo/Revolut web apps).

subtasks.name: Section spacing
subtasks.description: Add 40-48px vertical gaps between major content blocks (header → gauge, gauge → AI summary, summary → card feed). Current content is packed too tight. Let sections breathe.

tasks.test: Every spacing value is a multiple of 8. Content is centered with 480px max-width on web. Sections have clear visual separation through whitespace alone.

tasks.name: Home Screen Redesign
tasks.description: Transform from debug panel to product. This is the first screen users see — it must feel like money.

subtasks.name: Hero balance section
subtasks.description: Replace 'Plaid x OpenClaw PoC' title + status + test buttons with: a greeting line (time-of-day aware, reuse Insights pattern), a large centered balance number (34px bold), and a subtle +/- change indicator below it.

subtasks.name: Bank connection card
subtasks.description: Replace raw PlaidLinkButton with a Card component: icon + 'Connect your bank' title + 'Link your accounts to get started' subtitle + primary Button. Show only when no accounts connected. After connection, replace with account summary card.

subtasks.name: Transaction list redesign
subtasks.description: Each row: 40px circle with merchant initial (colored by category hash) on left, merchant name (body bold) + date (caption, gray) stacked in middle, amount right-aligned (body bold, negative=danger color, positive=success color). White background. No dark tiles. Divider: 1px #F3F4F6 between rows. Group by date with sticky headers.

subtasks.name: Unify Home to light theme
subtasks.description: Remove all #1e1e1e, #2c2c2e dark overrides. Home screen now uses the same light background (#F9FAFB) as Insights. One visual identity across the app.

tasks.test: Home screen shows balance hero, clean transaction list with merchant avatars, and Plaid CTA as a beautiful card. Zero debug UI visible.

tasks.name: Card System Redesign
tasks.description: Elevate the CardRenderer from functional to delightful. Cards are the core unit of insight delivery.

subtasks.name: Update CardRenderer to use <Card> base
subtasks.description: Refactor CardRenderer to extend the new Card component. Remove inline shadow/border/radius definitions. Use Card's tint prop for type-based background washes: warning → rgba(245,158,11,0.04), danger → rgba(220,38,38,0.04), success → rgba(22,163,74,0.04).

subtasks.name: Icon container redesign
subtasks.description: Increase icon container from 44px to 48px. Border-radius from 12 to 16. Use token accent colors at 0.1 opacity for background. Icon size 24px.

subtasks.name: Action buttons to full-width
subtasks.description: Replace tiny pill action buttons with full-width <Button variant='secondary'> at bottom of card. If multiple actions: stack vertically with 8px gap. Primary action gets variant='primary'. Think Airbnb's 'Reserve' button prominence.

subtasks.name: Do/Don't card layout
subtasks.description: Two-column layout with green left column (Do) and red right column (Don't). Each item: small colored dot + text. Clean separation. No heavy borders or backgrounds — just color and whitespace.

tasks.test: Cards feel premium, spacious, and actionable. No tiny pills. Each card type has a distinct but subtle personality through background tint.

tasks.name: Insights Screen Polish
tasks.description: The Insights screen is closest to good. Push it to great.

subtasks.name: SpendingGauge hero treatment
subtasks.description: Increase gauge size from 150x100 to 240x160. Center it as the hero element of the screen. Add animated fill on mount (0 → value over 800ms, ease-out). Below gauge: current pace in large text + 'vs $X avg' as caption.

subtasks.name: Ledger's Take redesign
subtasks.description: Remove left-border blockquote style. Replace with a full Card component with subtle brand-tint background. Add a small Ledger avatar/icon (32px circle) top-left. Title stays uppercase caption style. Body text: 22px, italic, 500 weight. Feels like a personal note from your financial advisor.

subtasks.name: Card feed spacing
subtasks.description: Gap between cards: 16px. Section title 'Your Insights' uses h3 variant with 32px top margin. Add subtle fade-in animation on each card (staggered 50ms).

subtasks.name: Empty state with illustration
subtasks.description: Replace activity indicator + 'Analyzing finances...' with: a minimal line illustration (wallet or chart), h3 'Crunching your numbers', body caption 'This takes a few seconds'. Centered vertically. Use Lottie or a static SVG.

tasks.test: Gauge animates on mount. Ledger's Take feels personal. Cards fade in with stagger. Empty state is beautiful.

tasks.name: Chat Screen Redesign
tasks.description: Move from 2015 chat bubbles to a modern conversational UI.

subtasks.name: Message layout overhaul
subtasks.description: Drop colored bubbles. Both user and agent messages are left-aligned. Agent messages: small Ledger avatar (28px circle) + message on white Card (sm). User messages: no avatar, light gray background (#F3F4F6), same left alignment. Thin timestamp between message groups. This is the Airbnb messaging / Linear style.

subtasks.name: Input bar redesign
subtasks.description: Full-width rounded pill input (radii.full, 48px height). Background #F3F4F6. Send icon INSIDE the input, right-aligned, 32px circle with brand accent color. No separate button. Subtle focus ring on input active. Placeholder: 'Ask Ledger anything...'

subtasks.name: Typing indicator
subtasks.description: Replace spinner + text with animated 3-dot pulse. Three 8px circles in a row, sequentially scaling up/down with 150ms stagger. Color: neutral gray (#9CA3AF). Below a small Ledger avatar. No text label.

subtasks.name: Inline card parity
subtasks.description: Cards rendered inside chat messages use the same CardRenderer as Insights feed. Ensure padding, shadow, and spacing match. Max-width of inline cards: 100% of message container. No visual jank.

subtasks.name: Chat header
subtasks.description: Minimal header: Ledger avatar (40px) + 'Ledger' name (body bold) + 'Financial Analyst' caption below. Centered or left-aligned. Subtle bottom border (#F3F4F6). No 'Talk to Ledger' subtitle.

tasks.test: Chat feels like a premium messaging app. No colored bubbles. Input is a sleek pill. Typing indicator pulses. Cards render cleanly inline.

tasks.name: Navigation & Tab Bar
tasks.description: Tab bar is the persistent frame of the entire app. Make it invisible until needed.

subtasks.name: Tab bar redesign
subtasks.description: Add text labels below each icon: 'Home', 'Insights', 'Chat'. Active state: filled icon + bold label + brand accent color. Inactive: outline icon + regular label + #9CA3AF gray. Tab bar background: white with top border #F3F4F6 (1px). Height: 64px (+ safe area).

subtasks.name: Tab transition animations
subtasks.description: Cross-fade between tab screens (200ms ease). No hard cuts. Use React Navigation's built-in animation config or custom interpolator.

subtasks.name: Active tab indicator
subtasks.description: Small dot (6px circle, brand accent) above or below the active icon. Animates position on tab switch (spring animation, 300ms).

tasks.test: Tab bar has labels. Active state is obvious. Transitions are smooth. Tab bar feels like part of a premium app.

tasks.name: Motion & Micro-interactions
tasks.description: Animation is the difference between 'functional' and 'delightful'. Add purposeful motion everywhere.

subtasks.name: Card entrance animations
subtasks.description: On Insights screen load: each card fades in (opacity 0→1) and slides up (translateY 20→0) with staggered 50ms delay. Duration: 400ms. Easing: ease-out. Use Animated API or react-native-reanimated.

subtasks.name: Gauge animation
subtasks.description: SpendingGauge arc animates from 0 to target value on mount. Duration: 800ms. Easing: ease-out. The number below also counts up. Satisfying and informative.

subtasks.name: Pull-to-refresh branding
subtasks.description: Custom pull-to-refresh indicator: small Ledger icon or brand mark that rotates/pulses during refresh. Replace default ActivityIndicator.

subtasks.name: Button press feedback
subtasks.description: All buttons scale down to 0.97 on press (100ms spring). Opacity drops to 0.8. Release springs back. Haptic feedback on iOS preserved.

subtasks.name: Success celebration
subtasks.description: When spending zone is green: subtle confetti burst or checkmark animation on the gauge. Brief (1s), non-blocking. Reward good behavior. Consider lottie-react-native for this.

tasks.test: Cards animate in. Gauge fills smoothly. Buttons feel tactile. Green zone triggers a small celebration. App feels alive.

tasks.name: Emotional Design & Edge States
tasks.description: Every state is a branding opportunity. Empty, loading, error — all should feel intentional.

subtasks.name: Empty state: No accounts connected
subtasks.description: Illustration (minimal line art of a wallet or bank) + h2 'Your finances, one view' + body 'Connect your bank account to get personalized insights' + primary Button 'Get Started'. Centered. Generous whitespace.

subtasks.name: Empty state: No transactions yet
subtasks.description: Illustration (minimal receipt or calendar) + h3 'No transactions yet' + caption 'Transactions will appear here once your bank syncs'. Centered.

subtasks.name: Error state
subtasks.description: Illustration (minimal broken link or cloud) + h3 'Something went wrong' + caption with specific error context + secondary Button 'Try Again'. Never show raw error messages or status codes to the user.

subtasks.name: Time-of-day theming
subtasks.description: Extend the greeting pattern: morning (6-12) gets a warm background wash (subtle warm gradient or warm-tinted header), evening (18-24) gets a cooler tone. Subtle — just a hint of warmth/coolness in the top 200px of the screen.

subtasks.name: Ledger personality
subtasks.description: Create a small avatar/icon for Ledger (32px circle, brand accent background, 'L' initial or simple robot/brain illustration). Use it in: Chat messages, Insights 'Ledger's Take', loading states. Gives the AI a face and builds trust.

tasks.test: Every possible state (empty, loading, error, success) has a designed experience. Ledger has a visual identity. Time-of-day adds warmth.

execution_order.note: Phase 1 is a hard blocker. Phases 2-3 can run in parallel tracks. Phase 4 is polish — ship without it if needed, but it's what separates good from great.

guiding_principles: One palette. One typeface. One grid. One shadow. No exceptions.
Every pixel should feel intentional. If you can't explain why it's there, remove it.
The app should feel like it was made by someone who respects your money and your time.
Animations serve understanding, not decoration. If it doesn't help the user, cut it.
Design for the state the user is most likely in, but make every other state beautiful too.
